violations.why: closer2_isr can preempt main between its two reads of test_global_var1 in JudgeCondi, so the reads can return different values.
writer2_isr can preempt main between the two reads of test_global_var2, so the reads can return different values.
closer2_isr has higher priority and can preempt closer1_isr after it writes 42. Its release routine resets the flag to 0, so closer1_isr's check at line 756 fails.
closer2_isr can preempt closer1_isr between the write of 0 at line 423 and the write of 42 at line 426. closer2_isr's release check at line 369 then reads the intermediate value 0.
